tail_method: Discrete power-law maximum likelihood; k_min by smallest KS distance with at least 50 tail nodes; 200 bootstrap draws; semi-parametric goodness of fit with 500 draws, tails drawn exactly from the discrete power law; Vuong tests against lognormal and exponential, nested test against a cutoff
attachment_method: Conditional logit: choice probability proportional to (k + 1) ** alpha among each event's candidates. Standard errors treat events as independent, so they are optimistic.
percolation_method: 20 random replicates per fraction on one realization of each graph; collapse is the first tested fraction leaving a largest component under 1% of original users
limits: Formula values are large-network approximations. Comparisons are descriptive and do not identify a mechanism.
